sloka: तत्र काञ्चनचित्राङ्गैः शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।दिशश्चकार विमलाः प्रदिशश्च महाबलः ।। ६.४४.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: tatra kāñcanacitrāṅgaiḥ śarairagniśikhopamaiḥ ।diśaścakāra vimalāḥ pradiśaśca mahābalaḥ ।। 6.44.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Mighty Rama with his shafts that were like flames of fire, decorated with gold, brightened in all directions.
